takeaways: The best unused CSMP material here is the March 2023 photo set: the tomato-soup, burrito and udon plates plus the influencer tasting shot (cells 11, 1, 24, 21). Use them to refresh work/csmp and to illustrate blog:themed-content-calendar-food-brands. For the hero loop's vertical stacks, the raw kitchen-action clips are the real find: Mario Media's diced peppers dropping into a container, the fry cutter and a plating moment (cells 19, 22, 29), and the Nov 2022 pulled-pork and shrimp plating close-ups (cells 14, 30). Check credit for the Mario Media test shoot first. The March/May 2023 reel-cover sets work as a small grid showing the themed series (Chef's Choice, Spotlight, Influencer/Expert in the Kitchen) on the blog or on service:organic-social. Keep the Oct/Nov 2022 woodgrain template graphics and published-story screenshots off the site: they look dated and carry visible typos ('CLIENT TESTIMONAL', 'INGREDIANT') and 'INSERT LINK HERE' placeholders. The May 2023 folder is 123 unedited ARW files, and only the roasted-carrot plate (cell 22) is worth exporting.
